invariant.subject: voyager
invariant.source: In 1989, NASA's Voyager 2 became the first-and only-spacecraft to study Neptune up close.
invariant.relation: An encounter no other spacecraft has repeated

candidates: The story is about Voyager 2’s close-up study of Neptune in 1989. It was the first—and, according to the supplied material, the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close, making this a singular encounter that no other spacecraft has repeated.
- **Development:** In 1989, NASA’s Voyager 2 studied Neptune up close, becoming the first spacecraft to do so.
- **Endpoint:** The encounter remains unrepeated: Voyager 2 is the only spacecraft identified as having studied Neptune up close.
